# Blogs API — operations

8 operations. Full request and response shapes: [reference.md](reference.md).

- `blogs.check-url-slug-exists` — **Check url slug** — `GET /blogs/posts/url-slug-exists` (read, location)
  The "Check url slug" API checks whether a blog post url slug is already in use for the location.
- `blogs.create-blog-post` — **Create Blog Post** — `POST /blogs/posts` (write, location)
  The "Create Blog Post" API allows you to create a blog post for any given blog site.
- `blogs.get-all-blog-authors-by-location` — **Get all blog authors** — `GET /blogs/authors` (read, location)
  The "Get all blog authors" API returns the blog authors for a given location ID.
- `blogs.get-all-categories-by-location` — **Get all blog categories** — `GET /blogs/categories` (read, location)
  The "Get all blog categories" API returns the blog categories for a given location ID.
- `blogs.get-blog-post` — **Get Blog posts by Blog ID** — `GET /blogs/posts/all` (read, location)
  The "Get Blog posts by Blog ID" API returns the blog posts for a given blog site.
- `blogs.get-blog-post-by-id` — **Get Blog Post by ID** — `GET /blogs/posts/post/{postId}` (read, location)
  The "Get Blog Post by ID" API returns a single published blog post, including its content/body, for the given location.
- `blogs.get-blogs` — **Get Blogs by Location ID** — `GET /blogs/site/all` (read, location)
  The "Get Blogs by Location ID" API allows you get blogs using Location ID.
- `blogs.update-blog-post` — **Update Blog Post** — `PUT /blogs/posts/{postId}` (write, location)
  The "Update Blog Post" API updates an existing blog post for any given blog site.
